root_cause_verification.rationale: The task was to revert files to a529bf91 state, undoing the dev's CSS changes. git diff a529bf91 confirms both BashView.tsx and SidebarBashView.tsx have zero diff from a529bf91 — the revert is exact. The original a529bf91 commit has borderBottomLeftRadius, borderBottomRightRadius, and overflow:hidden on the container, plus showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}. The dev's changes (removing these from container, adding to moreContainer, enabling scrollbar) are fully undone.
